title: Predefine feature steps and report development usage by step
goal: Release optional upfront feature plans, dated effort per step and conserving step usage reports
acceptance: Upfront feature steps show remaining effort and completion without advancing parent acceptance
Step usage totals conserve feature totals and retain unknown coverage
Owned fixtures, independent review, green CI and published release tag
privacy: Neutral fixtures and private metadata only; no prompts, secrets or invented usage.
validation: Source/render/report join fixtures and full deterministic template checks
escalation: Material acceptance or effort expansion requires owner agreement; routine detail does not

effort.basis: Initial scope includes policy, renderer, step reports, fixtures and release. Existing task storage is reusable; client adapters remain F-048.
